content_html:
Fabric Expansion Joint

Custom-fabricated multi-layer fabric expansion joints built by PT Misuba Guna Indonesia for absorbing severe thermal growth, duct misalignment, and low-pressure gas vibrations. Unlike metal bellows, our non-metallic fabric joints absorb simultaneous multi-directional movements (axial, lateral, angular) with minimal spring rate reaction forces on boiler casings, ID/FD fan housings, and turbine exhaust stacks.

Built with high-grade outer elastomeric covers (silicone, fluoroelastomer, or EPDM), gastight PTFE chemical barriers, and thick thermal insulation belts (needle-felted ceramic fiber and high-silica fiberglass cloth).

Custom Engineering Consultation & Ordering Guide

When requesting a custom fabric expansion joint quote, please provide your duct flange dimensions (round or rectangular), normal & maximum operating temperature, flue gas media composition (SOx, NOx, fly ash abrasive concentration), and expected movement range. Our technical team will recommend the optimal multi-layer fabric build for your ducting layout.
quote_checklist: Duct size and shape (round or rectangular)
Duct pressure or vacuum, and dust or condensate load
Axial, lateral and angular movement to absorb
